title: Skyscraper complex stalk recovery
statement: For a ringed space X, point x and stalk-module cochain complex M, the stalk of the termwise ringed-module skyscraper complex at x is nonempty-isomorphic to M.

source.place: the filtered-colimit stalk computation in the proof of lem-pc-skyscraper-complex

proof.text: For a stalk module N, send n to the germ at x of the constant global section with value n. Restriction of this section shows that its germ is also represented by the constant section on any neighbourhood of x.

Represent a scalar in the stalk ring by a section a on a neighbourhood U. The germ_smul identity for presheaves of modules identifies the germ of a times the constant section with germ(a) times its germ. The sectionwise skyscraper action is exactly germ(a) acting on its value, proving linearity.

For injectivity, Mathlib TopCat.Presheaf.germ_eq gives a neighbourhood on which two constant sections agree; evaluate there at the membership proof of x. For surjectivity, TopCat.Presheaf.exists_germ_eq represents any stalk element by s on U. Since PLift(x in U) is a subsingleton inhabited by hx, s is the constant function with value s(hx). Thus the constant-section germ is bijective.

Pointwise skyscraper morphisms take constant sections to constant sections. TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor_map_germ_apply therefore proves naturality of the linear bijections. Apply this to every differential of M, use LinearEquiv.ofBijective and HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoOfComponents, and invert the resulting isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: Tag 009A (4); explicit constant-section germ proof of the neighbourhood-colimit stalk computation, followed by naturality and degreewise assembly. Lean argument written by G1.

mathlib_searches.query: skyscraper sheaf complex is acyclic if and only if its stalk complex is acyclic

Mathlib/Topology/Sheaves/Skyscraper.lean has C-valued skyscraper stalk declarations but no O_X-module complex theorem.

lean.statement:
theorem skyscraper_complex_stalk_recovery (X : RingedSpace.{u_complex}) (x : X)
    (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u_complex} (X.presheaf.stalk x)) ℤ) :
    Nonempty (((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X x).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
        (((ringedModuleSkyscraperFunctor X x).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj M) ≅ M)
